name: Horseshoe Magnet
summary: Red U-shaped horseshoe magnet with grey pole tips and optional attraction lines; for science and physics scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tips stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 340 px wide and 400 px tall (hero size); use about 0.3–0.4 next to a person

params.name: lines
params.note: true = show attraction lines beside the tips

params.name: anim
params.note: pulse = the attraction lines fade in and out (needs lines true)

author: krakujs
